snippet.title: Dream of Pixels Trailer - iPhone, iPad, Android and Windows Phone
snippet.description:
Dream of Pixels is a beautiful falling blocks puzzle game.

http://dawnofplay.com/DreamOfPixels

Fantastically clever, brilliant, lovely, seriously impressive and awesome are just a few of the adjectives our game Dream of Pixels got from renown critics and satisfied users from all over the world.

"If only I could look up and touch a tetromino-filled sky... Until then, I thankfully have Dream of Pixels."

★ 90/100 ★ toucharcade.com, John Polson ★

★ 100/100 ★ AppAdvice.com
★ 100/100 ★ PadGadget.com
★ 90/100 ★ Modojo.com

★ Game of the Week ★ Modojo.com
★ Game of the Week ★ AppAdvice.com

★ App of the Day ★ GameTrailers.com
★ App of the Day ★ Kotaku.com GAOTD
